abstract: This project describes a revolutionary chat application that leverages efficient voice cloning technology to revolutionise digital communication. With the help of this invention text messages can be now personalised and sent as audio messages with the sender's voice. The proposed system captures the authenticity of the sender's speech by smoothly integrating AI algorithms to mimic vocal patterns and nuances. This study develops a trustworthy and adaptable voice replication system by implementing developments in neural networks and speech processing. Using a combination of deep neural networks and chat application development, the project aims to analyse and capture detailed human vocal patterns. The algorithm extracts the subject's vocal characteristics, intonations and speech patterns using as few human voice samples as possible. This method enhances communication quality in general and emotional expression. The application aims to combine application development and deep learning with advanced options, pushing the boundaries of technical innovation. This synopsis focuses on the creation of bridging the text-voice divide, enhancing the accessibility, personalization, and engagement of digital communication.

articleTitle: Hybrid CNN Classifier for Accurate Detection of Oral Cysts in Panoramic Dental Radiograph
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In dentistry, machine learning approaches play a significant role in the early detection and diagnosis of oral cysts. When planning accurate medical treatment, oral and maxillofacial surgeons can benefit from preoperative detection of these cysts. Surgical planning is directly affected by classifying oral cysts as dentigerous, radicular, ameloblastoma, odontogenic carcinoma, and odontogenic keratocyte. In dentistry, the outcomes of differential diagnosis based solely on imaging are unacceptable. This research proposes a three-step framework for autonomous cyst classification, segmentation, and detection based on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). To begin, DENT-CNN, a modified CNN architecture is proposed to classify the oral cyst as normal or abnormal. Second, UNet is a CNN variant used to segment the categorized cyst regions on panoramic dental images. Third, the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) is combined with CNN to identify segmented cysts as benign or malignant. The proposed work is extensively evaluated using 1500 real-time dental panoramic radiographic images of the oral cyst collected from a dental hospital. To alleviate overfitting, the data augmentation approach is used. The performance of the proposed work is analyzed in terms of a cyst classification rate of 96.8 %, a Dice Score of 96.3 % for cyst segmentation, and an accuracy for the Identification phase of 96.5%.

articleTitle: Enhanced Medical Image Fusion Through Laplacian Pyramid Decomposition and Weighted Averaging
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This work provides a medical image fusion method to improve image quality and preserve important diagnostic features by use of Laplacian Pyramid Decomposition and weighted averaging. The method breaks images into several layers, using Laplacian pyramids to capture high-frequency components and then reconstructs them with weighted averaging. Using this approach to multi-modal medical images such as Magnetic Resonance Imaging and Positron Emission Tomography scans improves visual quality and information retention noticeably. Using entropy of 4.8615, standard deviation of 86.9258, and structural similarity index of 0.9395, experimental results show better clarity and fusion performance, therefore offering important information for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning.

articleTitle: Efficient Hand Rehabilitation Recognition for Spy-Robot Controlling System
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The advancement of gesture recognition technology has been greatly influenced by the introduction of innovative devices. These devices have significantly improved hand pose recognition through more accurate tracking of hand movements, enhancing human-computer interaction have led to increased accuracy in gesture recognition and the feasibility of real-time applications. This brief introduces an improved and an efficient hand rehabilitation gesture recognition controlled system employing gesture sensor to provide reliable performance and a spy-robot control mechanism. The potential of gesture recognition technology spans diverse applications, from sign language recognition to assistive robotics and industrial automation which is thus discussed below.

articleTitle: NeuroVision: A Comparative Machine Learning Framework for MRI-Based Diagnosis of Alzheimer's and Brain Tumors
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Neurological diseases like Alzheimer Disease (AD) and brain tumors are some of the complex diseases that make early diagnosis challenging. Due to such complexities, treatment at the right time often experiences delays in neuro disorders, thus affecting the patient's condition. NeuroVision focuses on improved initial diagnosis accuracy. To achieve the higher precision, the advanced techniques like data augmentation, noise reduction, and hyper-parameter tuning to reduce false positives. Primarily, it is achieved with MRI imaging to be used for more accurate assessment. In the interest of simplicity, four different models of machine learning SVM, Random Forest (RF), Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Neural Networks are compared to determine the best model to use in reviewing MRI scans from patients with Alzheimer Disease and brain tumors. Because features between the two conditions share considerable overlap, the aim here simply is to identify the best performing model for attaining diagnostic accuracy. The metrics used to measure the performance in this study are accuracy, precision, recall, Fl-score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC). The accuracy of the model on the test set reports an accuracy of over 92 % for Alzheimer's whereas, for the case of brain tumor, the precision is about 82%. Comparing KNN that resulted in being the best model for Alzheimer's disease because this one is simple and accurate, while a neural network performed better when it comes to brain tumor diagnosis for the robust achievement of accuracy and adaptability in recognizing difficult-to-pattern.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Shifted Inverted Euclidean-Linear Kernel with Stacked Classifiers for Tamil Slang Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This study introduces a novel SVM-based method for classifying Tamil slang using a Hybrid Shifted Inverted Euclidean-Linear Kernel. The kernel integrates Eigen value shifting and clipping to ensure stability and positive definiteness that combines distance-based similarity with regularization techniques. Applied to voice samples from four Tamil dialects such as Chennai, Kovai, Madurai and Nellai, features like Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients, Pitch, and Energy were extracted and fused. The hybrid approach, enhanced with a stacked classifier system, outperforms traditional kernel functions (Linear, Radial Basis Function, polynomial, sigmoid) and machine learning algorithms (K Nearest Neighbor, Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, Decision Tree, Random Forest). Results show that the Combined Kernel achieves the highest accuracy, balanced precision, and recall, offering a scalable method for dialect classification with applications in speech recognition and linguistic analysis.

articleTitle: Social Media Review Prediction Based on Sentimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The influence of Social Media is having a huge impact on each and every aspect of life as such, Social Media is now playing a vital role in the lives of people, people used to communicate with others through the social media, reviews and comments from all the people are continually taken into consideration in every analysis made, for us to arrive to a conclusion, Hence, analysing the sentimental analysis of feedback and evaluations will play a major role in decision making of the future. In this study, an Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) model is used to predict the sentimental evaluation of reviews posted on social media, resulting in greater accuracy.

articleTitle: RAG-Enhanced Large Language Model for Intelligent Assistance from Web-Scraped Data
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The explosion of online information necessitates efficient and accurate methods for retrieving and analyzing relevant data. This research proposes a novel framework that leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques to address this challenge. The framework utilizes web scraping to extract information from various sources and employs advanced language models like Llama 3, Mistral, and Gemini to generate concise and informative summaries. Furthermore, the framework incorporates embedding models such as nomic-embed-text and Gemini embedding model text embedding 001 to create semantic representations of the retrieved data and utilize FAISS for efficient indexing and retrieval. The RAGAS framework was used to evaluate the performance of different LLMs, with Llama 3.1 demonstrating the highest accuracy at 86.67%. This framework has significant implications for various applications, including personalized education, where it can be used to provide students with tailored learning materials and personalized tutoring experiences.

articleTitle: IoT Based Manhole and Drainage Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This Aim: To develop a scalable, IoT -based monitoring system that enhances the safety and maintenance efficiency of urban drainage systems and manholes by providing real-time detection and alerts for blockages, hazardous gases, structural cracks, and water level fluctuations. Materials and Method: The Arduino UNO as the central processing unit, SIM900 GSM module for communication and sensors are Ultrasonic (SR-04), Tilt, Water level, MQ2 Gas, DHTII (Temperature & Humidity). The cloud-based IoT platform for data monitoring and analysis. The Integration of multiple sensors to continuously monitor manhole conditions and the data from sensors is processed by the central processing unit and transmitted via the GSM module. Real-time data is sent to a cloud platform, where it is analyzed and visualized for continuous monitoring. The automated alerts are generated and sent to authorities when anomalies are detected. Result: The system demonstrated high accuracy in detecting blockages, gas leaks, structural cracks, and abnormal water levels. It achieved a rapid response time of 3 seconds from anomaly detection to alert transmission. The cloud platform successfully managed and analyzed data from multiple monitoring units in real-time. The system was found to be cost-effective and scalable, making it suitable for large-scale urban deployment.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Agro-Innovation: Blockchain and IoT Convergence for Water Optimization and Weed Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into agriculture has significantly transformed precision farming by enabling data-driven decisions through real-time analytics. However, ensuring the security and authenticity of the extensive data produced remains a critical challenge. This paper introduces an innovative IoT-based precision agriculture system fortified with blockchain to optimize crop irrigation and enable intelligent weed detection. Using predictive analytics, the system effectively forecasts the water needs of crops, reducing excess use and promoting efficient water management. At the same time, machine learning-based weed detection helps to identify unwanted plant growth, cutting down on the reliance on chemical herbicides. A key element of this system is the Blockchain-IoT Precision Agriculture (BIPA) Framework, designed to safeguard sensor data and uphold transparency in agricultural processes. This framework ensures that sensor data remains unaltered and traceable, facilitating secure data sharing among different stakeholders. Results from experiments indicate a 23% improvement in water utilization efficiency and an 18% reduction in herbicide consumption, promoting environmentally friendly and sustainable agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Optimizing Medication Compliance through Machine Learning and IoT for Personalized Health Management
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies have revolutionized the healthcare industry, particularly in the field of medication administration. Inadequate adherence to medication is a serious worldwide issue that can result in poor health and higher medical expenses. Through continuous monitoring and analysis of patient-specific parameters, such as vital signs, medication history, and lifestyle factors, the system dynamically adjusts medication schedules and dosages to optimize therapeutic efficacy while minimizing adverse effects. The system tracks medicine usage, vital signs, and ambient variables using data gathered from Internet of Things (IoT) devices like wearable devices and smart pill bottles. An ML model, trained to anticipate potential adherence problems, is then provided with this preprocessed data. Personalized interventions, like medicine reminders, educational content, and progress reports, are delivered by the Intelligent Medication Compliance System (IMAC) based on these predictions. The integration of IoT-enabled smart sensors and connectivity allows for smooth communication between patients, healthcare professionals, and medicine dispensers, permitting prompt interventions, prescription reminders, and remote monitoring. Additionally, the system makes it easier for patients and medical professionals to communicate, allowing for prompt modifications to treatment programs. Serving as an anticipatory system, the IMAC provides personalized interventions. Predicting possible adherence problems, such as missing doses or inadvertent drug interactions, is done by the model through data analysis. The proposed IMAS seeks to empower patients, personalized medication management, and eventually improve medication adherence by fusing real-time IoT data with ML-driven insights.

articleTitle: Improving the Longevity and Efficiency of Electric Vehicle Batteries with Innovative Battery Management Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The project focuses on improving the performance and life of electric vehicle (EV) batteries through advanced battery management (BMS) technology. The system integrates three lithium-ion batteries, each with special functions for energy saving and distribution, ensuring the stable operation of the car. The BMS is like the brain of the battery, playing an important role in monitoring the health of the battery, controlling the voltage and current limit, and preventing problems such as overcharging or undercharging that can reduce battery life over time. Solving problems encountered in electric vehicle operation. These smart machines can predict potential problems by analyzing usage patterns, environment, and battery health indicators and recommend timely interventions to extend battery life and maintain performance. These types of technologies also encourage innovation and change to pay more for better energy use and reduced waste. This approach not only makes electric vehicles safer, but also reduces overall maintenance costs, improves reliability and supports the consumer electronics ecosystem. The main goal of this project is to increase the overall efficiency and service life of electric vehicle batteries by optimizing delivery costs and measuring the battery. By self-monitoring the power supply and using relays to control the power flow, the system ensures that each cell operates within the optimum range, protecting against unbalanced charging that can cause batteries to age faster. This new approach to battery management will contribute to the advancement of EV technology by improving the quality and efficiency of EV batteries.

articleTitle: OGCP: Experimental Evaluation of Epilepsy Disease Prediction Using Optimized Gradient Classification Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent seizures, and accurate, real-time prediction of seizures is critical for timely interventions. This study presents an Optimized Gradient Classification Principle (OGCP) with a Hybrid Deep Learning (DL) Model for predicting epilepsy from EEG signals. The proposed model was evaluated using the Epilepsy Seizure dataset from Kaggle and compared against nine well-established models, including CNN, LSTM, GRU, ResNet50, XGBoost, and SVM. The performance of the models was evaluated based on key metrics such as accuracy, precision, F1-score, recall, inference time, and model size. The proposed model outperformed all other models, achieving an impressive accuracy of 96.89%, precision of 94.56%, and F1-score of 95.78<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. The model's inference time was 43.4 ms, making it suitable for real-time applications. Additionally, the model's relatively moderate size of 57.9 MB ensures efficient deployment in memory-constrained devices. These results demonstrate the superiority of the OGCP-based Hybrid DL model for epilepsy prediction, making it a promising approach for medical applications where accuracy and real-time performance are crucial. Future work will focus on improving inference time and incorporating additional physiological signals to enhance predictive performance.

articleTitle: Secure Cloud-WSNs with Advanced Intrusion Detection System using Kepler Optimization and Bi-ConGRU Network Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As WSNs are popularly used in the contemporary world in various fields such as environmental monitoring, smart cities, monitoring and controlling of infrastructure and several essential activities, a detailed cloud security of the WSNs is vital. However, the establishment of these networks has come with new enormous security concerns such as peoples' unauthorized access, data leakage, and cyberattacks to these networks and all that leads to a compromise and poor performance of these networks. To solve these problems, it is necessary to apply high-quality and effective approaches to improve intrusion detection and meliorate the network's robustness. Based on the identified issues, this paper aims to discuss the critical problems and challenges in WSN cloud security with advances in intrusion detection systems that can address the emerging threats. Conventional approaches are not very effective in generalizing the threats or accurately detecting and preventing them as they cannot analyse the high dimensional data and learn from the new attack types. To eliminate these issues, the following approach has been developed including the Kepler Optimization Algorithm, KePO, and the Bi-Directional Convolutional Gated Recurrent Unit Network, BiConGRUNet. Thus, the KePO algorithm is used for feature selection resulting in the dataset improvement to boost up the intrusion detection system. The BiConGRUNet model takes advantage of state of the art deep learning methods, thus allowing for the two-dimensional analysis of network traffic. The current strategy focuses on considerable assessment with the help of benchmark datasets, including CICIDS-17 and UNSW-NB15, to prove the efficiency of the presented model.

articleTitle: Beyond 5G Network for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: A Survey on Non-Terrestrial-Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The integration of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) into Beyond 5G(B5G) networks represents a pivotal advancement in telecommunications, enabling high-quality connectivity for diverse applications across urban, rural, and remote areas. This survey proposed a comprehensive analysis of the present state of B5G networks for UAV applications, addressing key areas such as dynamic mobility management, interference management, and the requirements for latency-sensitive, energy-efficient communication. Two critical challenges spectrum scarcity and high-power consumption are identified as primary obstacles in UAV-NTN enabled B5G networks. This survey addressing these issues, this paper proposes improve the issues using MIMO (multiple-input multiple-output) and millimeter-wave (mm Wave) technologies and the flexible solar panel to save energy and costs. The MIMO method is giving the multiple output and multiple input at a time to communicative without any obstacles. The results demonstrate significant improvements in Quality of Service (QoS) metrics and packet delivery ratios, renewable energy sources validating the proposed approach for enhancing UAV-NTN communication in B5G environments.

articleTitle: Deduplication of Image Files to Reduce the Redundancy in Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Efficient cloud storage management is critical as the volume of digital content grows exponentially. Redundant image files contribute significantly to storage inefficiencies, increasing costs and affecting retrieval performance. This project proposes a scalable deduplication system for cloud storage, focusing on reducing redundancy, optimizing storage space, and enhancing operational efficiency. The objective is to ensure that only unique image files are stored, while duplicates are replaced with references to existing files, thereby conserving resources and improving data management. The proposed system utilizes a combination of SHA-1024 hashing for precise detection of identical files and perceptual hashing algorithms to identify visually similar images. These algorithms ensure comprehensive identification of duplicates, including nearidentical files. The process begins with image ingestion, where unique hashes are generated for each file. These hashes are compared against an existing metadata store to detect duplicates. Identified duplicates are stored as references, reducing storage space requirements, improving retrieval speed, and minimizing bandwidth usage by avoiding repeated transmissions. The deduplication system also enhances backup and disaster recovery processes by reducing the volume of files to be managed, resulting in faster backups and recovery times. By integrating this framework with cloud environments, such as Azure, the solution delivers scalability and real-time operation. This work addresses the growing challenges of data redundancy in cloud storage, contributing to efficient and sustainable storage practices.

articleTitle: A Detailed Investigation of Packet Loss in VANETs Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks(VANETs) are highly susceptible to packet loss due to their dynamic nature. Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) dynamically adjusts the sending rate to prevent congestion. However, not all packet losses are a result of congestion, bit errors in the wireless channel also contribute significantly to packet loss. Identifying and addressing the cause of packet loss can significantly boost TCP's performance. VANETs rely on wireless channels for packet transmission, which are prone to bit errors. This study utilizes AI-driven Machine Learning algorithms of varying complexities with some as simple as Logistic Regression and Decision Trees extending to more complex models like Support Vector Machines, Artificial Neural Networks and ensemble models like Random Forest and XGBoost to classify packet loss. These models analyze the complex relationships between network features to determine the root cause of packet loss. Metrics used to evaluate each model include accuracy, precision, recall and f1-score Using ns-3, an open source network simulator, a VANET was simulated to generate realistic datasets. The study reveals that Random Forest outperforms other models with an accuracy of 95%, owing to its capability to capture non-linear relationships. By improving TCP's performance through accurate packet loss differentiation, this study aims to pave the way for robust communication in smart transportation systems ensuring consistent network conditions even during high traffic conditions.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization in Wireless Sensor Networks Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are interconnected systems composed of spatially distributed autonomous sensors that collaboratively monitor physical or environmental conditions. These sensors are equipped with computational ability, sensing capabilities, and wireless communication technology. WSNs have gained widespread prominence due to their versatile applications across various fields, including environmental monitoring, healthcare, industrial control, home automation, and more. Maximizing the network's lifespan by minimizing energy consumption is the main challenge in the WSNs.To achieve this the weighted fuzzy-c means clustering (WFCMCDL) algorithm with deep learning is proposed to select cluster heads. WFCMCDL is a clustering technique that assigns data points to clusters based on their proximity to cluster centers, it is utilized to determine sensor nodes suitable as cluster heads by considering criteria such as node history, remaining energy ratio, and distance from the sink node. These criteria significantly contribute to the stability and efficiency of the selected cluster heads. The methodology assigns weightings to these criteria based on their significance in WSN operations, aiming to enhance stability and efficiency in selecting cluster heads. The simulation results compared with the Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) protocol, reveal significant enhancements in network stability specifically 97% improvements, for certain parameters. The findings of the study indicate that utilizing the methodology for CH selection proves to be effective and enhances WSNs energy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Rehabilitation Outcomes: A Hybrid Cognitive-Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Traditional rehabilitation methods often focus on a single impairment, leading to challenges such as low motivation and inadequate responses to the diverse needs of patients, time taken for appointments, and lack of personal monitoring of health status. To address these issues, The model employs meta-cognitive strategies, dynamic adaptive training, and modified Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) within an ensemble framework, targeting multiple impairments while tailoring interventions to individual patient requirements. A hybrid model proposed would integrate cognitive and machine learning methodologies to enhance personalized rehabilitation. By selectively employing meta-cognitive strategies, dynamic adaptive training, and modified Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) within an ensemble framework, the proposed system aims to bridge existing gaps in rehabilitation practices. The hybrid system is designed to efficiently manage patient data, reduce the complexity of rehabilitation tasks, and optimize computational resources. The use of stacking as an ensemble method further mitigates biases and uncertainties associated with individual models, thereby improving the reliability of the rehabilitation framework. Preliminary outcomes indicate that this hybrid approach achieves superior accuracy and efficiency compared to traditional methods, ultimately enhancing adaptability to the varied needs and preferences of patients.

articleTitle: Real-Time Mobile Detection to Prevent Cheating in Examinations
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The widespread use of mobile phones in examination settings has become a significant concern, facilitating cheating and compromising the integrity of assessments. Mobile devices, with their access to online resources, communication platforms, and stealthy applications, pose a serious threat to maintaining a fair evaluation process. This paper presents a deep learning-based model designed for the real-time detection of mobile devices during examinations. The model is capable of accurately identifying mobile devices, including Android smartphones, tablets, and feature phones, while distinguishing them from other common items found in examination settings, such as calculators, books, notebooks, pocket diaries, and sunglasses. The proposed model is trained on a curated dataset, combining the Kaggle Driver dataset with a custom-built Classroom Resource Dataset (CRD) that includes labelled data of students in typical examination scenarios, both with mobile devices and permissible items. The model exhibits robust object classification capabilities, providing a reliable tool to enhance examination security by preventing the use of unauthorized mobile devices.

articleTitle: Time-Frequency and Framewise Self-Attention-based DNN with GradCAM++ for Noise-Resilient Environmental Sound Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In the robust IoT based system design, it is hard to make decisions incorporate the environmental sound features as well as to incorporate dynamic and noise resilient environments into the system. The development in the use of Environ- mental Sound Classification (ESC) in models which incorporates smart surveillance, monitoring and healthcare is gaining attention in the research. This paper proposes a novel architecture called the Time- Frequency and Frame wise Self-Attention-Based DNN with Grad- CAM++ for Noise-Resilient Environmental Sound Classification in order to minimize noise from sound spectrograms and focus on distinguishing the important sound details. Furthermore, the paper introduces GradCAM++ to refine spatial feature localization, and EfficientNetV2 to improve computational performance. Incorporating the latest state-of-the-art techniques, the model showed 93.01% accuracy and surpassed baseline results focusing the UrbanSound8K dataset.

articleTitle: A Robust Deep Learning Model to Predict Epileptic Seizures based on Electroencephalographic (EEG) Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Epileptic seizures are sudden, uncontrolled electrical disturbances in the brain, which can lead to significant medical complications if not accurately diagnosed and treated. Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used for monitoring brain activity, offering a non-invasive method to detect seizures. This paper presents a novel approach Deep Neural Optimum Transformation (DNOT) for epileptic seizure prediction based on EEG signals using a hybrid deep learning model, Convolutional LSTM AutoEncoder (CLSTM-AE). The proposed model leverages the strengths of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for spatial feature extraction and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) layers for temporal dependency modeling. The AutoEncoder component ensures dimensionality reduction and reconstruction, allowing the model to focus on the most relevant features of EEG signals. The DNOT mechanism optimizes the feature extraction and learning process, transforming EEG data into an optimal latent space for improved classification performance. We evaluated the model using the Epileptic Seizure Recognition dataset, comparing its performance against nine existing machine learning and deep learning models. The proposed model achieved a remarkable accuracy of 96.58%, significantly outperforming conventional models like Random Forest, XGBoost, and deep learning models like ANN and LSTM. Other performance metrics, including precision (95.43%), recall (96.12%), and Fl score (95.77<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), further demonstrate the model's effectiveness. This methodology offers a reliable, high-accuracy solution for seizure prediction, providing significant potential for improving medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Accident Detection System in GHAT Roads
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Drivers are at critical risk of damage or loss of life in a coincidence on GHAT roads due to its tight bends, steep inclines, and variable climate. This observe introduces a “Accident Detection System” created especially for these tough terrains. To become aware of abrupt deceleration, collisions, or rollovers, the counseled system combines real-time sensor records from accelerometers, and GPS modules. Potential accidents are identified by the device through the usage of an intelligence set of rules that tracks car motion styles and environmental data. The generation guarantees brief reaction and assist by mechanically sending email to emergency offerings the automobile's GPS coordinates, coincidence kind, and severity over wi-fi communication protocols upon detection. By combining numerous technologies right into a single platform, GHAT roadways can improve emergency response instances and road protection, which lowers the quantity of fatalities and injuries. The gadget's layout, components, and implementation are described in this examine together with experimental findings that show the gadget's dependability and accuracy.

articleTitle: DMT2 Patient Recognition Using Cascaded Back Propagation Neural Network with Lasso Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This Diabetes Mellitus Type 2 (DMT2), a persistent metabolic syndrome, is characterized by elevated blood glucose levels due to the body's decreased reactivity to insulin. Timely and accurate detection for people with DMT2 is essential for efficient management and medical care. This paper presents a new method for identifying patients with type 2 diabetes (DMT2) by combining a Cascaded Back Propagation Neural Network (CBPNN) with Lasso Regression. The suggested approach combines the advantages of deep learning with statistical regression methods. The CBPNN is used for extracting and categorizing features, while Lasso Regression is employed for selecting and reducing the dimensions of features, guaranteeing that only the most relevant characteristics contribute to the ultimate decision-making process. This hybrid strategy improves the model's capacity to generalize and mitigates the danger of over-fitting. The suggested model's performance was assessed using a dataset that included clinical and biochemical indicators of patients both with and without DMT2. The findings indicated that the combination of CBPNN and Lasso Regression had better result as compared to conventional machine learning techniques in terms of accuracy, precision, and recall. For the implementation of proposed approach used matrix libratory R 2020b and used prima India data set for evolution of proposed method.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Intelligent Daycare: Enhancing Child Safety with IoT and Machine Learning Innovations
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Child safety and well-being in daycare settings are important, thus it is vital that the persons in charge be attentive to them. This research tries to solve the problem by introducing a smart and detailed monitoring system that utilizes new technology to enhance safety and support caretakers. The system has various innovative features, such as child missing detection, behavior and facial expression analysis, cry analysis and categorization, and fall detection. Using high-resolution cameras and on-device Edge AI capabilities, it ensures real-time surveillance of children's activities while protecting privacy. The approach integrates behavior and facial expression analysis to assess emotional states, cry recognition to discover childcare needs, as well as a useful fall detection system that can tell the difference between falls and other movements. All these parts synergize to hand over the necessary information to the caregivers on time and in a way that they can act upon. The quantitative experiments in real-time childcare centers show high accuracy through all the components, attesting to the system's reliability and durability. This research has important significance in improving the safety and the frequency response in daycare centers because it gives caregivers automated tools to quickly address the needs of children. While promising, the system has drawbacks, such as potential biases in data models and a reliance on ideal environmental circumstances. Future work intends to improve flexibility across varied daycare situations, improve accuracy through larger datasets, and investigate ethical frameworks for wider application.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Online Power Status Monitoring Using Sensor Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The reliability and efficiency of power distribution networks are crucial for maintaining uninterrupted services and operational safety. Distribution transformers, which are vital components of these networks, frequently experience failures that lead to widespread outages and safety concerns. Traditional monitoring systems are reactive, focusing on post-failure analysis, which often results in delayed interventions. To address this, a Comprehensive Online Power Status Monitoring System using sensor technology is proposed. This system employs high-precision sensors to monitor critical transformer parameters such as voltage, current, oil temperature, and oil levels in real-time. Data collected from the sensors is transmitted via GSM/4G/5G modules to a cloud-based platform where AI algorithms analyze the data to predict potential failures. The system supports predictive maintenance by identifying anomalies and faults before they occur, significantly reducing downtime and maintenance costs. A dual notification mechanism alerts both service personnel and end-users about faults and power restoration times, enhancing operational transparency and customer satisfaction. This scalable solution is adaptable to various transformer sizes and networks, providing a proactive approach to transformer management. The system integrates with existing power management frameworks, ensuring seamless upgrades and future-proofing. The proposed solution improves power distribution network reliability, reduces operational costs, and optimizes maintenance schedules, making it ideal for modern power infrastructure.

articleTitle: Estimating Surface Soil Moisture based on Remote Sensing Data and Crop Yield Classification using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Soil moisture plays a critical role in environmental monitoring and sustainable agricultural practices due to its significant impact on crop growth, water availability, and overall ecosystem health. Properly understanding and managing soil moisture is vital for efficient water usage, especially in agriculture. Traditional methods in measuring soil moisture have been confined to ground-based small-scale methods, which are high price due to high labor intensity and limited spatial coverage. This project addresses its limitation in the spatial view by integrating remote sensing data from the Sentinel-1 satellite. Sentinel-1 is particularly effective in monitoring the soil moisture as it captures data in all climate conditions. By combining the satellite data with Google Earth Engine (GEE) we create a soil moisture dataset. For analyzing the joint satellite and ground truth data, the machine learning technique using Random Forest (RF) is applied and classification of crop yield is done.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Supervised Classification Techniques for Land Use and Land Cover Mapping in Kalyan-Dombivali Region
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper explores the Land Use and Land Cover (LULC) classification of multispectral images in the Municipal Corporation of Kalyan-Dombivali city, Thane district, Maharashtra State, India. The research work utilizes a Landsat 8 OLI-level 2 images from 2023 year and applies the supervised classification techniques: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Maximum Likelihood Classifier (MLC), Random Forest (RF), and Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM) to categorize an image into five LULC classes: Water body, Built-up area, Vegetation area, Barren area, and Agriculture area. The purpose of this research work is to evaluate and compare the performance of these classifiers by evaluating metrics such as User's accuracy, Producer's accuracy, F1 score, Overall accuracy, and Kappa coefficient. After performing the evaluation, it is observed that, the SVM classifier technique achieves the highest results, with an overall accuracy of 94.43% and a kappa coefficient of 0.92, following with the MLC classifier technique which results an overall accuracy of 90.84% and a kappa coefficient of 0.86. The Random Forest classifier technique achieves an overall accuracy of 88.24% and a kappa coefficient of 0.83. The SAM classifier technique, performing the least effectively among the techniques mentioned, achieves an overall accuracy of 82.79% and a kappa coefficient of 0.71. This research work delivers valuable perspectives into land use and land cover classification, supporting the evaluation and sustainable resources management in the investigation area. The observations of this research work is useful to improve decision-evaluation methods and provide a robust foundation for future research endeavors in the region.

articleTitle: Next-Gen EV Battery State Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As the automotive industry accelerates towards electric vehicles (EVs), accurately predicting battery states has become pivotal for ensuring performance optimization, safety, and longevity. This project introduces a novel methodology leveraging Explainable Data-Driven Digital Twins to enhance battery state predictions in EVs. The approach integrates advanced machine learning algorithms, including Deep Neural Networks (DNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Random Forests (RF), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). It addresses challenges in predicting key battery parameters such as State of Charge (SOC) and State of Health (SOH) across diverse operating conditions. The primary objective is to develop a robust and interpretable digital twin framework that achieves high prediction accuracy and provides actionable insights into battery behavior using explainable AI techniques. The model combines the strengths of multiple algorithms to improve prediction reliability and adaptability in real-world scenarios. Initial results demonstrate the model's superiority over conventional methods. This solution offers scalability for advanced battery management systems and contributes significantly to the advancement of intelligent electric mobility.

articleTitle: Advances in Speech and Text Processing for Dravidian Language: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This review explores recent advancements in speech and text processing for local and under-resourced languages, emphasizing Dravidian languages. This work analyze 40 studies on topics such as speech recognition, sentiment analysis, emotion detection, and language identification, highlighting the growing use of deep learning techniques like CNNs, LSTMs, and transformers. Trends include multimodal and code-mixed language processing, and the use of both traditional and modern feature extraction methods. Key findings emphasize the success of hybrid models, the value of transfer learning and the need for high-quality datasets. The review also identifies gaps, including handling dialectal variations and addressing ethical considerations in language technology and also Industry, innovation and Infrastructure.

articleTitle: Improved Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory for Heart Disease Diagnosis using Statistical and Entropy Feature Set
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A wide range of illnesses that harm the heart are defined as heart diseases. As per the statistics of WHO, heart disease is presently the world's largest cause of mortality, nearly 18 million people die yearly. The major causes of cardiovascular disease the unhealthy practices together with health disorders such as obesity, high cholesterol, higher triglyceride levels, high blood pressure, and others. Presently, various open-access resources are available and numerous studies are conducted to enable the usage of various computer technologies for the accurate detection of disease earlier. Currently, DL and ML are emerging technologies that significantly contribute to the medical domain. To further enhance the diagnostic accuracy, a novel Heart Disease Diagnosis (HDD) approach is proposed in this study. Initially, the min-max normalization is employed to preprocess the input data. Subsequently, features such as entropy and statistical features are retrieved from the preprocessed outcome. Finally, the derived features are subjected to the improved Bi-LSTM (IBi-LSTM) classifier for effective diagnosis of heart disease. Additionally, a comprehensive experimental analysis is conducted to investigate the performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network using Metaheuristic Improved Harris Hawks' Optimization Algorithm for Weed Classification in Cotton Crops
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In agricultural fields, weeds are undesirable plants and play a vital role. Weeds are fast-growing plants that thrive in disturbed environments; thus, cotton fields are a prime target. They readily germinate in tilled soil and compete with cotton for essential elements, such as water, sunlight, and nutrients. This competition can significantly impact cotton yield. Weeds can stunt cotton plant growth, reduce boll (cotton fruit) production, and even reduce fiber quality. Currently, smart agriculture like plant disease identification, plant disease detection, weed detection and classification can be achieved through the use of various technologies. In this paper, we propose a DenseNet with Improved Harris Hawks optimization (DNIHHO) metaheuristic optimization algorithm based on weed detection and classification. Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO) is a new optimization technique designed to automatically find the best or nearly the best solutions to complex problems, surpassing human capabilities. Primarily, the presented DNIHHO technique uses the median filter (MF) to remove the noise from an image. The DNIHHO technique uses the DenseNet201 model for feature extraction and includes the IHHO algorithm for hyperparameter optimization in weed classification. The study indicates that this method attained an average accuracy of 97.78% in weed classification using the DN201 model, representing the highest accuracy among the Improved Harris Hawks Optimization (IHHO) weed classification techniques.

articleTitle: IoT-Enhanced Advanced Image Processing Techniques for Plant Disease Detection and Management
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Plant diseases often lead to significant agricultural losses, causing economic difficulties and food shortages. Conventional detection approaches are inefficient, challenging, and must have expert engagement, resulting in decreasing scalability. Recent developments, including machine learning and IoT-integrated systems, have enhanced real-time monitoring; However, they encounter obstacles such as restricted generalization to varied environmental circumstances, data imbalance, and insufficient adaptability to uncharacteristic diseases. This research tackles these issues by introducing an IoT-Enhanced Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) integrated with a One-Class Support Vector Machine (SVM). The model utilizes IoT for real-time data collection, CNN for effective feature extraction, and One-Class SVM for anomaly identification. Experimental results indicate the system's exceptional performance, attaining 95.6% accuracy, a 3.4% lower rate of false positives, and 97.2% precision, offering a scalable, automated solution for early disease detection, minimizing crop losses, and enhancing agricultural sustainability.

articleTitle: An Effective Investigation on Health Cloud Based IoT Based Virtual Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: An effective investigation into a Health Cloud-based IoT virtual health monitoring system has been conducted using advanced remote monitoring technology powered by the ESP8266 micro controller. The system integrates various sensors, including the ECG sensor (AD8232) for heart activity, the DS18B20 for body temperature, the MAX30100/MAX30102 pulse oximeter for heart rate and oxygen saturation, the BMP280 for respiration rate, and a pulse sensor for accurate blood pressure monitoring. With sensors directly controlled by the ESP8266 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module, these would ensure real-time data transference to the Arduino Cloud platform. Other features are real-time monitoring, a large user base, and safe transmission and storage with advanced security protocols for the sensitive medical data. The system enables proactive health management by providing remote access to patient health metrics for healthcare providers, thus allowing for early detection of anomalies and timely medical intervention, which leads to improved patient outcomes. This investigation demonstrates the potential of integrating IoT with cloud platforms to deliver a scalable, secure, and efficient virtual health monitoring solution, enhancing healthcare accessibility and responsiveness.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity using Machine Learning Strategies for Phishing Defense
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cybersecurity experts continue to be concerned about phishing attacks because it causes a real risk to people, businesses, and economies all around the world. Phishing attacks cause a critical threat to global cybersecurity, necessitating effective classification methods for phishing URL operations. So, this work aims to categorize phishing URL operations into distinct types: deceptive, spear, whaling, and pharming. Leveraging machine learning techniques including logistic regression, support vector machine, Naive Bayes, decision tree, K-NN, and Perceptron, evaluate their efficacy in accurately identifying and classifying phishing attacks. The findings underscore the importance of these models in providing cybersecurity professionals with actionable insights into the diverse tactics employed by malicious actors. Among the evaluated models, logistic regression emerges as the preferred choice, demonstrating superior performance in accurately categorizing phishing URLs. This work contributes to enhancing cybersecurity defenses by offering a comprehensive framework for understanding and mitigating the impact of phishing attacks on digital ecosystems.

articleTitle: Smart Anomaly Detection in Solar Power Plants with Auto Encoder and LSTM Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Detection of anomalies in solar power plants is a critical task for the analysis of operating conditions so as to optimize the outcome in terms of safety and output. Due to scaling-up of renewable energy resources, it is imperative to detect abnormalities in photovoltaic (PV) systems on time in order to avoid large losses and avoid possible dangers like failure of equipment or fire. However, a number of techniques which are used for anomaly detection are generally accompanied by problems with regards to its versatility, efficiency and accuracy during its application for real-time analysis of large scale multi-dimensional time-series data. It is possible that traditional approaches have difficulties in capturing the rich structures and temporal interactions inherent in solar energy data, which results in slow response and higher maintenance requirements. In this paper, we present an AE+LSTM model to accommodate these challenges of anomaly detection for solar power plants. The proposed AE+LSTM combines the best of AEs which are good at learning compact fixed-sized representations of data and LSTM networks which are great for sequential data over time. It also deserves an improved view of sorting regular patterns of operation from other forms that need immediate attention or intervention. When comparing our work to current machine learning and deep learning approaches, experimental results clearly reveal that the AE+LSTM model yields the highest accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Thus, using this model, the existing solar power plant's monitoring can be advanced by operators to improve general performance, reliability, and safety of energy generation.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Safety: Automated Helmet Detection and License Plate Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This research study addresses the increasing need for automated traffic enforcement solutions to improve road safety, focusing on helmet detection and license plate recognition for motorcyclists. With manual enforcement limited by factors such as human error, fatigue, and the sheer volume of traffic, an AI-driven system offers a scalable alternative. Leveraging YOLOv8 for object detection and EasyOCR for text extraction, the proposed system automates the detection of helmet violations and vehicle identification through number plates. The model operates by first detecting helmet usage, and if absent, proceeds to recognize the vehicle's number plate. It performs reliably in various challenging conditions like poor lighting, occlusion, and motion blur, making it suitable for real-time traffic monitoring. The research also addresses ethical considerations around privacy and data protection, ensuring compliance with legal standards. By reducing manual intervention, this solution enhances traffic enforcement efficiency, promotes road safety, and provides a scalable approach to monitoring traffic violations.

articleTitle: Enhanced Web Security Using Cross-Feature Analysis of Visual Design, Live Logs and Code Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Threats using website visual designs and content structures, along with standard coding vulnerabilities, represent an increasing danger to web security. To enhance web security, this paper introduces a new method called cross-feature analysis that integrates the investigation of visual design, live logs, code structures and other vulnerabilities. Based on this threefold correlation, this method identifies discrepancies that might have otherwise gone undetected by traditional approaches reliant on discrete elements. This research rightly provides a thorough methodology for evaluating XSS detection, SQL injection error and time-based testing, CSRF vulnerability checking, clickjacking protection, information disclosure detection, and risk assessment are all included in this. It includes several test vectors for each vulnerability, port scanning with service discovery, analysis of SSL/TLS and security headers, assessment of DNS setup, and integration of WHOIS data. Live monitoring is supported by real-time logging, and actionable insights to strengthen security posture across infrastructure and online applications are provided via a risk-based grading system with recommendations.

articleTitle: Secure Student Record Management using Visual Cryptography in Educational Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cloud computing is vital for data transmission and storage in the digital era, highlighting the urgent requirement for strong data security measures. Conventional encryption techniques such as RSA, while dependable, have considerable computational burden and energy requirements owing to their extensive key sizes. This study examines the efficacy of Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) as a superior solution for data security in cloud environments. The suggested method utilizes ECC's reduced key sizes to attain improved computational efficiency and energy saving, all while upholding rigorous encryption standards. A comparison research indicates that ECC surpasses RSA in performance and resource efficiency, rendering it especially appropriate for extensive cloud systems handling significant amounts of sensitive information. This research examines the implementation of the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm in Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode for image encryption. The AES-CBC technique efficiently safeguards images by transforming them into encrypted formats, so obstructing illegal access. Comparative assessments using alternative encryption methods highlight AES's enhanced security and computational efficacy. Collectively, these findings underscore the capability of ECC and AES to overcome the shortcomings of conventional encryption, providing secure and resource-efficient solutions for contemporary cloud computing issues.

articleTitle: Enhancing Factory Automation Through Facial Recognition Using Phoenix PLC and Factory I/O
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This research study explores the integration of facial recognition technology to enhance factory automation, utilizing Phoenix PLC and Factory I/O in a secure and efficient manner. The system employs a face terminal to capture and authenticate facial data, which is transmitted to a web server via Ngrok for secure communication. A Python script processes the facial data and, upon successful authentication, sends an access-granted message through MQTT to initiate automated actions. Node-RED facilitates the communication flow, with MQTT nodes receiving messages and OPC UA nodes delivering control commands to the Phoenix PLC. The PLC interfaces with Factory I/O, a simulation software, to trigger specific operations based on personnel authentication. This approach combines security and automation, ensuring only authorized personnel can initiate factory processes while optimizing operational efficiency. By leveraging MQTT for low-latency communication and OPC UA for reliable control, this methodology offers a seamless and secure solution for intelligent factory automation, highlighting the potential of interconnected systems in Industry 4.0.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis: A Comprehensive Study of Computational Techniques, Applications, and Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Natural language processing (NLP)'s sentiment analysis subfield has drawn a lot of interest because of its wide range of uses and developing computational methods. This paper offers a comprehensive review of the different computational approaches used in sentiment analysis, spanning from conventional techniques like rule-based approaches to sophisticated machine learning and deep learning models. In addition to discussing the difficulties in deciphering complex linguistic expressions, the research investigates how well these techniques categorize attitudes expressed in text, including positive, negative, and neutral sentiments. Furthermore, the study explores the applications of sentiment analysis in several fields, emphasizing its influence on business and technology. Examples of these domains include market research, customer feedback, and social media monitoring. This study seeks to provide a thorough review of well-known datasets that are used for sentiment analysis training and assessment, along with information on their features, advantages, and disadvantages. This study seeks to provide a thorough review of the state-of-the-art in sentiment analysis and recommend future prospects for research in this dynamic field by synthesizing recent breakthroughs and ongoing studies.

articleTitle: IoT-Driven Predictive Maintenance for Household Energy Meters: Enhancing Reliability and Efficiency Through Real-Time Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Inadvertent outages in household energy meters due to device failures can disrupt energy management and increase maintenance costs. To address this, a predictive maintenance system was developed, utilizing data from IoT-enabled energy meters to identify early signs of faults and prevent major failures. The system classifies various fault types with high accuracy, achieved through advanced data processing techniques. The results are visualized using Grafana on a custom web application dashboard, which integrates with MQTT for real-time data transmission. This setup provides operators with real-time metrics, interactive visualizations,enhancing the efficiency and reliability of household energy management while improving decision-making and reducing downtime.

articleTitle: Cyber Attack Detection in Healthcare Using Machine Learning and Multi Data Source
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Healthcare systems face a significant problem in detecting cyberattacks due to the increasing sophistication of attackers the framework uses sophisticated feature selection techniques and guarantees high accuracy reliability and security this paper presents a comprehensive framework for the detection and classification of attacks using machine learning algorithms like catboost and adaboost the framework leverages multi-source data from electronic health records medical device logs and network traffic by reaching an accuracy of 98% and a precision of 96% with adaboost the experimental findings show how successful the suggested method is additionally this research offers proactive identification and mitigation strategies that improve the cybersecurity resilience of healthcare systems

articleTitle: An Intelligent Early COPD Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This study presents a machine learning-based framework aimed at the early detection of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), a significant global health concern, emphasizing improved diagnostic accuracy and early intervention potential. Conventional diagnostic method like spirometry, face limitations in terms of time and accessibility, particularly in low-resource settings, leading to delayed diagnosis and treatment. The model presents a machine learning-based framework for the early prediction of COPD severity, utilizing clinical data from 101 patients in a rehabilitation program, and achieving prediction accuracies of 95.85% with Random Forest, 95.50% with Support Vector Machine (SVM), and 90.00% with Logistic Regression, demonstrating its potential as an effective diagnostic tool for improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: INNS: A Superficial Learning Scheme to Predict Complex Human Activity Behaviour using Improved Neural Network Schema
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) is a crucial task in various domains such as healthcare, smart homes, and fitness tracking, where real-time, accurate detection of human activities is required. In this work, we propose a hybrid model combining a Cascaded AutoEncoder (CAE) for feature extraction with a Random Forest (RF) classifier for human activity recognition. The model was evaluated against 9 existing models, including CNN, LSTM, GRU, ResNet, and MobileNet, using various metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and inference time. The proposed model achieved a superior accuracy of 93.87%, outperforming models like ResNet (90.11%) and MobileNet (91.23%). Additionally, the model showed competitive precision (92.45<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), recall (92.89<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), and Fl-score (92.50<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), along with an efficient inference time of 21.3 ms, making it suitable for real-time applications. The low memory usage (185 MB) further supports its deployability in resource-constrained environments. These results demonstrate that the hybrid CAE + RF model offers an optimal balance between high classification performance and computational efficiency, making it a powerful solution for HAR tasks.

articleTitle: Detecting Retinal Diseases Through the Implementation of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This study presents an innovative method for detecting retinal diseases by combining Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs) with advanced image processing techniques, specifically Gaussian filtering for pre-processing and Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) for segmentation. Initially, Gaussian filtering is applied to the retinal images to reduce noise and enhance image quality, improving the accuracy of subsequent analyses. During the segmentation step, the FCM algorithm is employed to divide the retinal images into distinct regions, enabling the identification of key structures, such as the macula, blood vessels, and potential lesions. The segmented images are then fed into a DCNN, which is trained to classify various retinal abnormalities, including diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and glaucoma. By integrating Gaussian filtering, FCM-based segmentation, and DCNN-based classification, the proposed approach provides a comprehensive framework for reliable and efficient retinal disease detection. Experimental results on publicly available retinal image datasets demonstrate that the method significantly enhances classification accuracy, effectively reduces noise, and improves the precision of abnormality detection. This integrated approach holds substantial promise for clinical applications, offering a powerful tool for early diagnosis and aiding in the management of retinal diseases.

articleTitle: Smart Living: An IoT-Driven Apartment Management System for Seamless Utility and Rent Billing
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This research presents “Smart Living,” an IoT-driven apartment management system designed to streamline utility and rent billing processes. By integrating IoT devices, such as Arduino Uno and NodeMCU ESP8266, with sensors for electricity and water consumption, the system provides real-time data on utility usage to both landlords and tenants. The system enhances efficiency and transparency in rent and utility management, enabling landlords to monitor tenant payments and utilities in real-time, while tenants can track their expenses effectively. The system was evaluated using ISO 25010 standards, achieving an overall mean rating of 3.39, indicating its effectiveness in improving the efficiency and convenience of apartment management. This innovative system has the potential to revolutionize apartment living by enhancing transparency, improving communication between landlords and tenants, and promoting more sustainable and efficient resource management.

articleTitle: Cyberbullying Detection and Severity Classification Using Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cyberbullying has grown to be a significant issue in the internet age, affecting individuals of all ages, particularly teens. It involves using internet channels to harass, threaten, or disparage people, often with lingering emotional and psychological repercussions. In social media platforms cyber bullying is becoming more and more common, which has raised the need for efficient tools to identify and remove harmful content. Based on the frequency of objectionable words, a system was created for this research to categorize tweets into four groups: neither, low, medium, or high. A Kaggle dataset was first cleaned and prepared by pre-processing with Keras and Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK). The offending severity level of the tweets was determined using a fuzzy logic with a triangular membership function. Several models were trained using that categorized datasets like Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM), Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT-Base) and DistilBERT. Among those models Bi-LSTM showed a high degree of accuracy with a precision score of 95.52%, recall of 95.48%, accuracy score of95.48%, and F1 score of 95.49%.

articleTitle: Improving EV Charging Performance by Streamlining Coil Alignment in Wireless Power Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The electric vehicle (EV) advertise is quickly developing, making a request for progressions in charging to coordinate the expanding ubiquity of EVs. Remote exchange (WPT) frameworks, inactive remote charging, a promising arrangement, particularly in areas like stopping parts, airplane terminals, and shopping centers where vehicles stationary for expanded times. Be that as it may, a critical challenge with inductive control exchange is the Misalignment of coils caused by how drivers stop, which decreases the effectiveness of control transmission and comes about insufficient charging. Conventional strategies have endeavored to address this issue by including more coils to progress arrangement; whereas successful, this approach complicates the plan and raises costs. This extend presents an imaginative method that streamlines the arrangement handle.

articleTitle: YOLOv8-Based Approach for Real-Time Kidney Stone Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The detection of kidney stones is critical for effective treatment and timing of intervention, and advances in computer vision techniques have greatly improved medical image recognition This paper presents a new method a kidney stones are detected using YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once, Version 8) deep learning model. of the introduction It was known for its accuracy, and is used to analyze Computed Tomography (CT) images for the diagnosis of kidney stones. The proposed system focuses on real-time detection, combining deep learning techniques to provide effective and scalable solutions for early diagnosis. The model is trained on advanced Computed Tomography (CT)images, showing high accuracy in detecting and localizing renal stones. The results of our study show that YOLOv8 offers promising results in terms of accuracy, recall, and diagnostic speed, thus suggesting that it can be used in clinical settings to provide diagnostic capabilities has been increased. The functionality is reintegrated into the web application to provide easy, real-time analysis.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Microcalcification Detection in Digital Breast Tomosynthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Breast cancer is becoming the most prevalent malignancy among Indian women. Mammography, one of the few modern screening methods available, has proven effective for early detection and treatment of nonpalpable, node-negative breast cancers. The advent of digital breast tomosynthesis has changed breast imaging by making it possible to get thin-section, multi-angle X-ray images that are much better at finding microcalcifications and other problems. Recent deep learning techniques have improved detection accuracy, yet challenges persist. Limited labeled datasets, noise interference, and difficulties in managing the high computational demands of 3D data reduce system efficacy. This review examines the deep learning applications used to detect microcalcifications in digital breast tomosynthesis. Microcalcifications are crucial indicators of early-stage breast cancer and are challenging to discern accurately with conventional methods. Deep learning methods and other advanced architectures have shown promise in automatically finding microcalcifications. These methods use the multidimensional data that digital breast tomosynthesis provides. These algorithms excel at learning intricate patterns and spatial relationships within breast tissue, enhancing sensitivity and specificity beyond traditional mammography. The review synthesizes recent advancements, highlighting the performance gains achieved by deep learning models in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and potential clinical impact. The integration of deep learning into digital breast tomosynthesis processes has the capacity to transform breast cancer care by improving early diagnosis and patient outcomes. This can be achieved through learning about model architectures, training methodologies, and conducting comparative evaluations.

articleTitle: Marching Forward: Redefining Human-Machine Interactions in Conversational AI Through Hybrid Intelligence, Blockchain Security, and Autonomous Agents
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Conversational AI has emerged as an essential instrument in enhancing human-computer interaction, with applications spanning customer service to personal assistants. This paper offers a comprehensive examination of recent developments in conversational AI, including novel techniques in natural language generation (NLG), dialogue systems, and dynamic response optimization. We analyze advancements including transformer-based architectures, reinforcement learning for dialogue generation, and retrieval-augmented models, emphasizing their roles in enhancing the quality and contextual accuracy of conversations. Additionally, we examine the feasibility of blockchain technology as the foundation for decentralized AI, promoting secure, transparent, and distributed frameworks for AI applications, hence improving privacy and control in data exchanges. Hybrid methodologies that combine symbolic reasoning with deep learning are analyzed, highlighting their effectiveness in addressing complex dialogues. These advancements, supported by empirical research and benchmark performance, signify the evolution towards more personalized, intelligent, and decentralized conversational systems.

articleTitle: Blockchain for Secure and Efficient Crowdfunding: An Optimized Particle Swarm Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Crowdfunding, a method of raising capital through collective contributions, often faces challenges related to transaction efficiency, security, and transparency. Blockchain addresses these issues by providing a decentralized, transparent, and secure environment for transactions, while smart contracts automate the fund release process based on predefined conditions. PSO, a nature-inspired optimization algorithm, is applied to optimize various crowdfunding parameters such as funding strategies, donor behavior, and campaign success. By combining PSO with blockchain, the proposed model improves both the speed and security of crowdfunding transactions. This research presents an innovative approach to enhancing crowdfunding platforms by integrating Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) with blockchain technology. Proposed Model achieves a 30% reduction in transaction time and a 40% improvement in security. This is achieved through the use of a Merkle tree for secure data storage and smart contracts to ensure efficient and automated fund management. The integration of PSO further optimizes key parameters, such as fund distribution and reward allocation, leading to a more efficient and transparent platform. The combination of these technologies results in a crowdfunding experience that is not only faster but also more secure and reliable, enabling global, borderless funding while minimizing fraud and enhancing trust among participants. This research highlights the potential of OPSA-enabled blockchain solutions to transform the crowdfunding landscape, offering a more efficient, secure, and transparent funding platform.

articleTitle: Super POS: An Interactive Web-Based Quantum Simulator with Real-Time 2D and 3D Visualizations
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Quantum computing demands innovative tools to support education and research. This paper presents SuperPOS, a web-based quantum simulator designed to fill specific gaps in current platforms by offering unique features, such as interactive 3D visualizations, that make quantum concepts more approachable for both newcomers and researchers.
